{{Top|leg}}
'''Nole trees''' were a species of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vernet]], capable of growing to heights over four [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. [[Yuri Stonelaw]] hid in a nole tree to escape [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] trainees searching for him with [[Infrared receptor|infra-red scanners]] after he tried to rescue his [[Kristoff Stonelaw|brother]] from a [[Vernet Imperial Army Training Camp|training camp]].<ref name="TD">{{JournalCite|15|The Draw}}</ref>
